data.one_liner: Convert between Vietnamese Lunar Calendar and Solar calendars.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes and functions to convert dates between the solar calendar and the Vietnamese lunar calendar. It supports calculations for years between 1800 and 2199, including handling leap months.
use_when: You need to convert solar dates to Vietnamese lunar dates in your Flutter or Dart app.
You need to convert Vietnamese lunar dates (including leap months) back to solar dates.
avoid_when: You need lunar calendar conversions for systems other than the Vietnamese lunar calendar.
You need dates outside the supported range of 1800 to 2199.
strengths: Supports classes (Lunar and Solar) for clean object-oriented usage.
Handles leap months accurately for the Vietnamese lunar calendar.
weaknesses: Recommended only for the Vietnamese lunar calendar system due to timezone and coordinate dependencies.
